construction_notes: Rates are computed per 100,000 children per year, separately by indigeneity and by four age buckets (0-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-17); single-year age was unavailable in Denmark and Greenland for privacy reasons
OOHC includes placements with non-kinship foster parents, with kinship caregivers where CPS is involved, and in group homes or other residential/institutional care; informal kinship care is excluded
Denmark: boarding school and dormitory placements excluded, which lowers observed rates especially among 15-17 year olds
United States: 1.6% missing indigeneity imputed by MICE using age, sex, state of residence, Hispanic ethnicity, other racial identifiers and TANF eligibility
Australia: counts of indigenous children in suppressed cells (<4 observations) imputed from the single-year age distribution of OOHC placements
Denmark: cells with counts below 5 are suppressed; restricted-use data on the distribution of suppressed counts were used to derive point estimates and confidence intervals
Greenland: annual counts including the residual placement category treated as an upper bound, excluding it as a lower bound; counts measure unique children in OOHC on January 1

Modeled rates: 1,000 parametric bootstrap iterations sampling from observed rates and their 95% CIs assuming normality, non-linear time trends fitted by GAMs with smoothing splines, prediction intervals sampled, and age-standardization to the WHO World Standard Population
Risk ratios: repeated sampling from distributions parameterized by indigenous and non-indigenous rate estimates and their 95% CIs, then division of sampled indigenous by sampled non-indigenous rates

Reference dates differ across countries: Danish ages as of December 31, Greenlandic as of January 1, AFCARS as of October 1; Australian counts by fiscal year from July 1, AFCARS by federal fiscal year from October 1, Danish by calendar year, Greenlandic point-in-time on January 1
